newsitem.title: USA: CSX dismisses Norfolk Southern pledge letter.
newsitem.headline: CSX dismisses Norfolk Southern pledge letter.

text.p: CSX Corp said on Wednesday a "pledge letter" Norfolk Southern Corp sent to Conrail Inc shareholders as part of its ongoing attempt to buy Conrail, was a "non-event."

Earlier on Wednesday, Norfolk Southern, which has made a $110 per share cash bid for Conrail, said it would formalize in a written agreement its pledge made earlier in the week that it would not participate in any agreements with CSX or Conrail that delivered less than a $110 per share cash offer.
Conrail has rejected Norfolk Southern's bid in favor of a cash and stock pact with CSX.
Norfolk Southern also said on Wednesday it was extending its tender offer through January 10, 1997.
But CSX said Norfolk Southern was misrepresenting its ability to close its tender offer.

"Norfolk Southern could not close its hostile tender offer on its previous expiration date of December 16, 1996, nor can it close on its rvised expiration date of January 10, 1997, or at any time thereafter until well into the summer of 1997 at the earliest..." CSX said.
